verdict.rationale: Fathom's documented REST API, SDKs and MCP server cover a meaningful but mostly read-oriented slice of the product: listing and filtering meetings, fetching transcripts and summaries, requesting recording downloads, managing webhooks, and listing users, teams, team members and meeting types. Many UI capabilities have no documented API surface, including clips, playlists, comments, folders, keyword alerts, CRM field sync, Deal View, scorecards and custom summary configuration, and API keys themselves must be generated in the web settings UI. missing for 10: write/management endpoints for clips, playlists, comments, folders and keyword alerts, API access to CRM sync, Deal View, coaching scorecards and custom summary templates, programmatic key provisioning, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), any documented statement or independent check of UI–API parity.
